levi.name: Levi
levi.bio: Levi bar Sisi, a disciple of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi whose own baraitot the Gemara cites as “Levi teaches.”
levi.prompt: A learned scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard flecked with grey and a plain linen mantle, holding a small scroll of teachings he has gathered and reciting from it. Stone columns of a Galilean study hall softly behind him.
